messages:
Ibrahim: Heads-up 0: Santos Systems (partner) found an onboarding bug: trial credits were auto-applied to enterprise accounts during April, creating over-credits they want reversed or reimbursed.
Keiko: Oof. Do we have a summarized liability and sample rows?
Ibrahim: They pasted CSV excerpt: `invoice_id,account,period,applied_credit,should_have,delta
inv-7712,Santos-Ent-01,2025-04,$3,600,$1,200,$2,400
inv-7719,Santos-Ent-07,2025-04,$2,800,$0,$2,800` Total stated = $15,600 across 12 accounts after proration.
Sofia: Is this partner-managed allocation or direct refunds to merchants? Their note: "prefer consolidated partner refund".
Martin: Ops preference: consolidated credit memo to Santos so they can reallocate. But for amounts >$10k we should confirm CFO sign-off and tax treatment.
Alyssa: Finance lead here 0: I can approve operationally but looping CFO given $15.6k. Also need GL mapping: suggest `GL-PARTNER-ADJ-2025Q2`.
finance-bot: Ticket FIN-5055 created for Santos corrective credit. Owner: Ibrahim. Status: pending approvals. Link: https://redwood.internal/fin/tickets/FIN-5055
Sofia: Legal note: check reseller contract re: partner liability windows. If error longer than 60 days, partner remedies limited.
Ibrahim: I scanned the contract; reseller audit window is 45 days. This bug spanned ~6 weeks, so contract doesn't fully cover. Legal suggested goodwill treatment.
Keiko: Tax-team, any VAT/us sales tax implications if we issue a partner-level credit?
tax-team: Quick reply: partner rebates may be considered adjustments for VAT depending on how Santos documents the pass-through. We need CSV and a statement from Santos about allocation mechanism before final tax advice.
Martin: Also ask Santos for banking details and a signed allocation ack (one-pager) confirming they will accept consolidated credit and distribute to accounts. We won't post until ack received.
Ibrahim: Pinged Santos legal. They responded: "Ack OK, will accept consolidated credit. Prefer wire to our treasury. Please reference SAT-APR-OVERCR-2025." Attached signed PDF.
Alyssa: Thanks. CFO DM'ed: okay to proceed with finance lead approval + one-line month-end note. CFO asked we tag it in the PL commentary and include payment ref.
finance-bot: FIN-5055 updated: attachments required: sample CSV, Santos ack PDF, approval thread link.
Sofia: Ops question: Do we refund (wire) or post a credit memo? Santos requested wire; partner treasury prefers cash. Wire increases ops friction but reduces recon churn.
Martin: Given their preference and the amount, wire seems reasonable. Use GL `GL-PARTNER-ADJ-2025Q2`. Memo: "Santos partner corrective reimbursement  Apr 2025 over-credits. Ref: SAT-APR-OVERCR-2025".
Keiko: Also request W-9 or local tax form for vendor payments (KYC/tax compliance) before wiring. Santos is US-based; ask for W-9.
Ibrahim: Santos provided W-9 in the thread. Uploading to FIN-5055.
finance-bot: FIN-5055 updated: W-9 attached. Status: ready for payment scheduling.
Alyssa: Approved. Sam (payments) 0: please schedule wire for 2025-05-05 to match cashflow runway. Add memo above and attach CSV to the ledger entry.
Sofia: I'll prepare the wire instruction and mark transaction as "Partner Correction  Santos" in the ledger. ETA posting 05/05.
Martin: Tax-team 0: please confirm any tax posting notes once CSV is attached.
tax-team: Will review attached CSV and provide a short note for month-end.
Ibrahim: After wire, please confirm here and update the Q2 reconciliation sheet so the PL shows the corrective.
finance-bot: FIN-5055 status changed to scheduled-payment. Payment date: 2025-05-05.
Sofia: Wire scheduled. Ref: TX-90021. Posting date 2025-05-05. :white_check_mark:
Alyssa: Thanks everyone. Month-end note for close: "Partner reimbursement to Santos Systems for April onboarding over-credits, $15,600. Posted 2025-05-05, ref TX-90021."
Ibrahim: Filing product request P-1367 to add a preflight gate for onboarding promo application and a reconciliation alert for partner-managed accounts.
Martin: Good. Closing FIN-5055 after posting and reconciliation update.
